modules.title: Module 8: Personal Care Skills
modules.summary: THE BIG ONE — 14 hours / 700 minutes. This cannot be one block; split into many sub-lessons (bathing, dressing, oral care, hair/nail, prosthetics, skin/decubitus, elimination, bowel/bladder, weighing). Demonstration-heavy. Plan this as roughly 8-10 mini-modules, each with its own time gate, so a student completes them across multiple sittings. Planned content: 670 min; required minimum: 700 min (currently under by 30 min — add or expand content to close the gap). Large module: build as multiple sub-lessons, each with its own time gate. Game candidate (med): skill sequencing — layer a reusable engine on top of the teach block, do not replace instruction with it.
